books.title: Book of Kells

read.licence: Kells excluded from CC-BY 4.0; permission required

books.why: Trinity's most famous manuscript, displayed beside the Long Room. Catalog only: digitalcollections.tcd.ie answers every curl request (incl. guessed /iiif/MS../manifest paths) with HTTP 200 HTML reCAPTCHA page, so no IIIF manifest URL could be verified. Trinity states images are generally CC-BY 4.0. Kells is an explicit exception: permission required.
books.quote: Kells (TCD MS 58), the Book of Durrow (TCD MS 57) and the Book of Armagh (TCD MS 52)
books.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' https://tcd.ie/library/research-collections/projects/early-irish-mss | sed 's/<[^>]*>/ /g' | rg -o 'Book of Armagh \(TCD MS 52\)'
books.rights_quote: digital images can be used under the terms of a CC-BY 4.0 licence ... There are some exceptions to this policy, including The Book of Kells (IE TCD MS 58) so permission for use should still be requested
